Critically: (1) light-mode .thumb-card bg = rgb(255,255,255) (was rgba(15,10,30,0.55)), (2) dark-mode .thumb-card bg = rgba(15,10,30,0.55) EXACTLY unchanged. action_items: Add [data-theme='light'] overrides for .settings-key-card (background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card)) plus nested input bg = var(--bg) to mirror the .thumb-card fix. Also bump the BYOK page hero/eyebrow text contrast (currently pale-on-pale).
critical_code_review_comments: v1.16.0 CSS additions (App.css L6589-6720) are well-scoped — they only override [data-theme='light'] surfaces and leave dark untouched. Verified live: dark-mode .thumb-card stays at exact rgba(15,10,30,0.55) byte-for-byte; light-mode reads rgb(255,255,255). Clean approach. ✓

All overrides route through design tokens (var(--surface), var(--bg), var(--muted), var(--warning), var(--accent)) — no new hardcoded colors introduced. Future theme tweaks will cascade automatically. ✓

Light-mode CTA uses var(--warning) (copper rgb(168,112,69)) with white text — strong contrast, matches Stripe-style primary action. Active engine/aspect chips correctly switch to warm-gradient + copper border. ✓

Gap: same fix pattern was NOT applied to .settings-key-card. Recommend extracting a shared 'card-surface' utility class (or @apply mixin) so all panel-style components route through one set of light-mode overrides. Otherwise this bug will keep reappearing for every new card component.

Minor: App.css is now 6734 lines — well past the maintainability threshold. Consider splitting into App.css (base) + thumbnails.css / settings.css / scripts.css per-page sheets, each owning their own [data-theme='light'] block.

rca of the issue: Original bug: .thumb-card / .thumb-tile / .thumb-seg / etc. were authored against the dark palette only — backgrounds were hardcoded as rgba(15,10,30,0.55) and rgba(8,5,20,0.6), text used cream/copper hardcoded values. There was no [data-theme='light'] cascade, so toggling the theme only swapped the design tokens but never reached these components. Fix: comprehensive [data-theme='light'] block at App.css L6589-6720 routing each surface through var(--surface), var(--bg), var(--muted), var(--warning), var(--accent). Same fix discipline still owed to .settings-key-card (and likely a few other card-shaped components) — confirmed bug there (6 cards leaking dark bg). Dark-mode remains pixel-identical (regression assertion in script confirms exact rgba(15,10,30,0.55) match).
